prompt:

Retain image1's familiar simple loose white shorts, two separate ragged hems, plain waistband and restrained folds. No twisting, wrapped panels or hanging central flap. Allow the natural thigh overlap to establish the step; do not force the fabric to cross over itself.
Match the Calm focus eyes in image2. Preserve image1's head/cap location, nose, beard, torso, arm positions and scale. Keep both feet within the horizontal range x240 to x810. Entire cap visible with40px top margin. Actual transparent alpha, no glow, background, shadow or labels. One full-body sprite.
